name: Chaptarr
description: Chaptarr is a Readarr fork built to manage both audiobook and eBook libraries in one instance, with narrator, multi-edition and series-aware organization.

notes.text: Chaptarr is beta software with no stable GitHub releases yet - only source tarballs marked as prereleases. This script builds it from source on every install/update, which needs the .NET 10 SDK and Node.js/Yarn and can take several minutes.
Source tree lives in /opt/chaptarr, the published app in /opt/chaptarr_app, and application data (including the SQLite database) in /opt/chaptarr_data.
Chaptarr can use an external PostgreSQL database instead of the default SQLite file - set the Chaptarr__Postgres__* environment variables in the systemd unit if needed.
MP3-to-M4B conversion (m4b-tool) is not installed by this script since it requires Docker-only pinned mp4v2 binaries; ffmpeg/ffprobe metadata extraction works normally.
